text:
Priya: Quick idea — let's ship a 1-week 'orientation sprint' checklist for new managers joining Redwood. compact, action-first, and calendar-ready.
Alex: Love this. Can we make it so hiring managers can copy a single calendar bundle?
Morgan: +1. Also include who-to-ask for infra/access, and a tiny 30/60/90 starter template.
Priya: Draft plan below — trying to keep each day focused and < 45m of scheduled time. comments?
Priya: Day 0 (pre-start): IT ticket open, laptop + VPN, Okta SSO, badge request, buddy assigned.
Alex: who handles badge for on-prem folks? @Sam?
Sam: Yup, I'll own badge/safety for office starts. Ping me with new-hire name and start date.
Priya: Day 1: welcome 30m w/manager, 30m HR admin (pay/benefits/NDAs), 30m buddy intro, 15m runbook on where to ask for creds.
Morgan: Suggest a 15m "how we deploy" primer for managers — quick hooks to Redwood Console and key SLAs.
Priya: Good call — add 15m infra primer (deploy + access).
Priya: Day 2: Product overview 45m, team sync 30m, set initial goals (30m) — include a 30/60/90 skeleton doc link: https://redwood.link/manager-30-60-90 (editable).
Alex: can we add a short checklist for immediate security must-dos? e.g., MFA, device encryption, KMS access request.
Priya: Yep: checklist itemized and prioritized. I'll paste below a copy-paste calendar set we can attach to offers:
Priya: ```
Calendar bundle (copy to invite):
- Day 1 09:30 - Welcome & manager intro (30m)
- Day 1 10:15 - HR admin + payroll (30m)
- Day 1 11:00 - Buddy intro / product tour (30m)
- Day 2 10:00 - Product overview (45m)
- Day 2 14:00 - Team sync + onboarding tasks (30m)
- Day 3 11:00 - Infra & security primer (30m)
- Day 4 10:00 - 30/60/90 kick-off (45m)
- Day 5 16:00 - End-of-week check-in + feedback (30m)
```
Sam: Nice. For on-prem/private deployment customers we should add a short checklist for compliance onboarding (legal + security contacts).
Priya: I'll add a two-line compliance flag: "If handling regulated data: schedule compliance intro with Security and Legal within week 1."
Morgan: For the 30/60/90 starter, can we provide 3 example goals for managers of infra, product, and platform teams? helps them translate.
Priya: Sure — small bullets:
- 30d: meet cross-functional partners, ship first small process improvement, finalize access/credentials.
- 60d: own a prioritized backlog item, start leading weekly planning, collect first feedback cycle.
- 90d: roll out one operational improvement, define OKRs for next quarter, present roadmap to stakeholders.
Alex: Can you include a snippet they can paste into their 1:1 agenda with direct reports?
Priya: Added short 1:1 template: "Wins / Blockers / Goals / Support needed" — 15m.
OnboardBot: Reminder posted: new-manager orientation template created. Link: https://redwood.link/orientation-sprint-template
Priya: Next steps: I'll make a single Google Calendar 'bundle' file + a one-page PDF cheat sheet. Sam/Morgan/Alex — can you review by EOD Friday?
Sam: I can review today after 2pm.
Alex: I'll take a pass tomorrow morning.
Morgan: Friday works for me.
Priya: Thanks — if we get sign-off, we'll add the bundle to offer pack and People-ops onboarding docs. Also thinking of a short "first-week survey" to capture friction points.
Alex: Do it. short 5 q's.
Priya: Cool. Also, tiny note for hiring managers: please create tech access tickets (Okta + infra) 3 working days before start to avoid delays.
Sam: can we automate a few of those tickets based on role? open org ticket for infra to explore.
Priya: perfect. wrapping — will post final doc/link here when ready. :sparkles:
